title: Effort to account for Soviet nukes after the collapse
summary: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen tells of Effort to account for Soviet nukes after the collapse, about 1991-1993 at Moscow, Russia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And the US government at that time launched a heroic really heroic effort with the Russians to try to account for every nuclear weapon.

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer, says he took part in a push in Moscow between about 1991 and 1993, just after the Soviet Union fell apart. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the US government worked with the Russians in what he calls a heroic effort to account for every Soviet nuclear weapon. He tells it as a time when the world's loose nuclear weapons had to be tracked down and secured.
